method unique_digits(x: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |x| > 0 // the input list must be non-empty
    ensures result == sorted({i | i <- x, has_no_even_digit(i) }) // result is a sorted list of elements from x with no even digits

method has_no_even_digit(n: int) returns (result: bool)
